description: This file defines an abstract class 'ColumnVector' representing in-memory columnar data in Spark, including APIs for data access, nested types, and resource management.

classes.name: ColumnVector
classes.description: An abstract class representing in-memory columnar data in Spark, providing APIs for data access, nested types, and resource management.

methods.name: dataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of this column vector.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Cleans up memory for this column vector; not usable after.

methods.name: closeIfFreeable
methods.description: Cleans up memory if resources are freeable; default calls close().

methods.name: hasNull
methods.description: Returns true if the column contains any null values.

methods.name: numNulls
methods.description: Returns the number of nulls in the column.

methods.name: isNullAt
methods.description: Checks if value at rowId is null.

methods.name: getBoolean
methods.description: Returns boolean value at rowId.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns byte array from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Returns short value at rowId.

methods.name: getShorts
methods.description: Returns array of short values from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Returns int value at rowId.

methods.name: getInts
methods.description: Returns array of int values from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getLong
methods.description: Returns long value at rowId.

methods.name: getLongs
methods.description: Returns array of long values from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getFloat
methods.description: Returns float value at rowId.

methods.name: getFloats
methods.description: Returns array of float values from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getDouble
methods.description: Returns double value at rowId.

methods.name: getDoubles
methods.description: Returns array of double values from rowId to rowId+count.

methods.name: getStruct
methods.description: Returns a ColumnarRow for struct type at rowId, or null if null.

methods.name: getArray
methods.description: Returns a ColumnarArray for array type at rowId.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns a ColumnarMap for map type at rowId.

methods.name: getDecimal
methods.description: Returns a Decimal value at rowId with specified precision and scale.

methods.name: getUTF8String
methods.description: Returns UTF8String at rowId.

methods.name: getBinary
methods.description: Returns byte array at rowId.

methods.name: getGeography
methods.description: Returns GeographyVal from binary data at rowId.

methods.name: getGeometry
methods.description: Returns GeometryVal from binary data at rowId.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns CalendarInterval at rowId, constructed from child vectors.

methods.name: getVariant
methods.description: Returns VariantVal from child vectors at rowId.

methods.name: getChild
methods.description: Returns child ColumnVector at given ordinal.
